nodes.norm_label: 18. применимое право и порядок разрешения споров

nodes.label: Bot Component
nodes.rationale: Handles Telegram commands, payments, subscription storage, user UUID syncing, subscription URL serving

nodes.label: Agent Component
nodes.rationale: Thin HTTP control plane on each VPN node; bootstraps Reality keys, manages live Xray config, exposes add/remove/sub API

nodes.label: Xray VPN Engine
nodes.rationale: Actual VPN traffic engine using VLESS + Reality + xtls-rprx-vision

nodes.label: Caddy HTTPS Proxy
nodes.rationale: Terminates HTTPS for subscription endpoint and proxies to internal bot HTTP server

nodes.label: Subscription Generation Flow
nodes.rationale: Bot dynamically builds Base64-encoded VLESS URI payload from all synced servers on each /sub/{token} request; no static config per user

nodes.label: Server Access Control
nodes.rationale: Each server has access_mode public or restricted; restricted servers use ServerAccessGrant whitelist; changes auto-reconcile UUIDs

nodes.label: No-Logs Policy
nodes.rationale: Connection logging disabled on VPN servers; only aggregated traffic stats stored, not content, IPs, or DNS queries

nodes.label: Cloudflare WARP AI Domain Routing
nodes.rationale: Google Gemini blocks datacenter IPs; traffic to Gemini domains only is routed through per-location WARP; all other traffic goes directly

nodes.label: Multi-Server Architecture
nodes.rationale: Main VPS runs bot+agent+xray+caddy; additional VPS nodes run only agent+xray; bot talks to extra nodes over agent_url

nodes.label: add_server.py Provisioning Script
nodes.rationale: Automates provisioning: SSH to new VPS, upload agent, start VPN node, read generated agent.env, register in bot database

nodes.label: SQLite Database
nodes.rationale: Default runtime database for VPS deploy; bot can also use PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL

nodes.label: agent.env Config File
nodes.rationale: Generated on first agent start; stores AGENT_TOKEN, XRAY_PORT, PUBLIC_KEY, SHORT_ID, REALITY_DEST, HOST_IP; shared read-only with bot container

nodes.label: MTProto Proxy (mtg)
nodes.rationale: Optional mtproxy profile service using ghcr.io/9seconds/mtg:2; only activated if mtproxy Docker Compose profile is enabled

nodes.label: Per-Subscription Connection Limit
nodes.rationale: connlimit.py enforces simultaneous-IP limit per subscription on the agent side
